description: Source code for the Front Panel helper class in a device management system, handling LED brightness, blinking patterns, and related controls within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, brightness, blinking patterns, and preferences within the plugin.

classes.name: FrontPanelHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing auxiliary functions such as setting remote LED state.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes indicators and power state.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::start
methods.description: Starts the front panel indicator management, initializes indicator list.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timer and indicator updates.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of all indicators.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets clock display brightness if enabled.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setLED
methods.description: Configures LED color and brightness based on parameters.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Begins blinking timer with specified repeat count.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED to a specific blink pattern.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blinking timer to update LED state.

methods.name: CFrontPanel::is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour mode.

methods.name: FrontPanelHelper::setRemoteLedState
methods.description: Sets remote LED state based on input.

methods.name: BlinkInfo::Timed
methods.description: Timer callback for blinking pattern execution.
